courseTitle: NativeScript + Angular: Build Native iOS, Android & Web Apps

cues.en: So that's it for this module in this module, we covered a lot of basics of the natives of the world.
We learned about these built in UI widgets like that label you can use and about the core layouts like
the stack layout or the flex box layout or the grid layout.
You learned about core components like label button textfield or a list you and we will see more such
It's really just a couple of core components you reuse over and over as you will learn.
Now you also saw that in the end you're building a normal angular app where you use the normal features
like event binding property binding to where binding here with Engy model to pass data around and add
your logic to your templates, just that the templates are now not HTML, but that native script XML
syntax so that native script can compile them to native code for the platforms we're running on.
Now you also learned about debugging and how you can start with debugging.
And with that we have a solid set of foundations which now allows us to proceed with the rest of the
course and work a bit more on our course project for which we, for example, will need more than this
single starting page we have here.
So in order to be able to navigate around and have different pages where we can do different stuff,
we need to learn all about routing and navigation in native script applications.
And that's exactly what we'll do in the next course module.
